title: CSIRO ScienceImage 7264 Cross section of advanced fibres produced by bicomponent extrusion
description: Bi-component fibres are produced from two different polymers which, when extruded together, can produce new fibres with new features. The two pifferent polymers can be seen in cross section, and can be arranged in different patterns. This photo shows the 'islands in the sea' pattern.
author: Bea Lipson, CSIRO

CSIRO ScienceImage 7264 Cross section of advanced fibres produced by bicomponent extrusion
Bi-component fibres are produced from two different polymers which, when extruded together, can produce new fibres with new features. The two pifferent polymers can be seen in cross section, and can be arranged in different patterns. This photo shows the 'islands in the sea' pattern.
